Smart Design, JUN 2025 - AUG 2025

Working at the Systems team cooperating with UX designers and mechanical engineers to define/prototype the UX of the SodaStream Fountain and conduct testing.

Relevent links

Contributions

  • Developed embedded firmware (STM32) for prototyping the HMI of the product, while working with UX design to test and fine-tune user interaction flow and hardware user interface.
  • Developed testing units for motor and pneumatic mechanisms in the product, including the electrical hardware, embedded firmware and host software. (PyQt)
